findings.finding: Successful Git inspection can carry an unreadable-state warning with empty stdout; the starter must not declare that state clean.
findings.resolution: Inspection stderr now holds before API access or branch creation; normal switch diagnostics remain separate. A red regression reproduced the gap and all eight boundary tests passed after correction.
